conjectures.title: Jacobian Conjecture
conjectures.status: Resolved for dimensions ≥ 3 in 2026; the plane case remains open
conjectures.statusZh: 2026 年解决三维及以上情形；二维情形仍开放
conjectures.author: Ott-Heinrich Keller

overview.summary: Can a polynomial map be locally invertible everywhere yet fail to be globally injective? OPBench asks models for explicit maps and finite collision witnesses that an offline symbolic program can check.
overview.summaryZh: 一个多项式映射能否处处局部可逆，却不是全局单射？OPBench 要求模型提交可由离线符号程序核验的显式映射与有限碰撞见证。

visualization.label: Three locally invertible sheets can share one target
visualization.labelZh: 三个局部可逆薄片可以映到同一目标
visualization.caption: The 2026 three-dimensional certificate combines a nonzero constant Jacobian with three rational points in one fiber.
visualization.captionZh: 2026 年的三维证书同时给出非零常雅可比与同一纤维中的三个有理点。

statement.intro: For a polynomial map over the complex numbers,
statement.introZh: 对于复数域上的多项式映射，
statement.explanation: the conjecture asserted that $F$ is a polynomial automorphism. A counterexample supplies distinct points $p\ne q$ with $F(p)=F(q)$.
statement.explanationZh: 原猜想断言 $F$ 必为多项式自同构。反例则需给出不同点 $p\ne q$，满足 $F(p)=F(q)$。
statement.note: Every displayed result is checked by an offline symbolic program. No LLM judge decides the algebraic verdict.
statement.noteZh: 所有展示结果均由离线符号程序核验，不使用 LLM judge 判定代数结论。

atlas.title: From Keller's question to auditable counterexamples
atlas.titleZh: 从 Keller 的问题到可审计反例
atlas.body: The frontier changed in July 2026: dimension three is false, stabilization settles every higher dimension, and dimension two remains the open core.
atlas.bodyZh: 2026 年 7 月前沿发生变化：三维命题为假，稳定化处理覆盖全部更高维度，二维仍是开放核心。

events.title: Keller formulates the problem
events.description: A nonzero constant Jacobian is conjectured to force polynomial invertibility.
events.descriptionZh: 猜想认为非零常雅可比必然推出多项式可逆。

events.title: Degree reduction reshapes the search
events.titleZh: 次数归约重塑搜索空间
events.description: Bass, Connell, and Wright reduce the general problem to special cubic-homogeneous maps.
events.descriptionZh: Bass、Connell 与 Wright 将一般问题归约到特殊的三次齐次映射。

events.title: A three-dimensional certificate is independently formalized
events.titleZh: 三维证书得到独立形式化
events.description: An explicit degree-seven map has determinant −2 and three distinct rational preimages of one point; Isabelle/HOL verifies the finite claims.
events.descriptionZh: 一个七次显式映射的行列式恒为 −2，且三个不同有理点具有同一像；Isabelle/HOL 核验了有限证书。

events.title: The geometry and higher-degree families are developed
events.titleZh: 几何机制与高几何度数族得到发展
events.description: A self-contained tangent-sweep account gives examples in every dimension above two and of arbitrarily large geometric degree.
events.descriptionZh: 切线扫描机制给出自足解释，并构造所有三维以上、任意大几何度数的反例。

benchmark.name: OPBench · Jacobian Counterexample Construction
benchmark.title: Five problems, one capability curve
benchmark.titleZh: 五级问题，一条能力曲线
benchmark.body: The suite moves from unconstrained construction to degree, fiber-size, and open two-dimensional frontiers. Every task uses the same exact certificate protocol.
benchmark.bodyZh: 题目从开放构造推进到次数、纤维大小及二维开放前沿，并共享同一套精确证书协议。
benchmark.hintNote: Each problem is evaluated both without a hint and with a reference-direction hint.
benchmark.hintNoteZh: 每道题均同时评测无提示与参考方向提示两种设置。
benchmark.footer: Novelty and exact generic-fiber degree are reported separately when they are not machine-verifiable; neither is delegated to an LLM judge.
benchmark.footerZh: 创新性与精确的一般纤维度数在无法程序判定时单独报告，且均不交给 LLM judge。

dataset.name: OPBench · Jacobian Counterexample Construction
dataset.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3\). No degree or sparsity restriction is imposed.
tasks.hint: Let \(u=1+xy\). A known three-dimensional construction is \[F_1=u^3z+y^2u(4+3xy),\qquad F_2=y+3xu^2z+3xy^2(4+3xy),\qquad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z.\] It satisfies \(\det J_F=-2\), and \[(0,0,-\tfrac14),\ (1,-\tfrac32,\tfrac{13}{2}),\ (-1,\tfrac32,\tfrac{13}{2})\] all map to \((-\tfrac14,0,0)\). The submission must be a genuinely new counterexample algebraically inequivalent to this reference. Reformulations, variable or component permutations, reparametrizations, and constructions obtainable by invertible algebraic coordinate changes in the source or target are inadmissible.

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3\) with \(\max_i\deg F_i\le 7\). Supply at least two distinct algebraic points \(p_1,p_2\) in one common fiber, so that \(F(p_1)=F(p_2)\).
tasks.hint: Let \(u=1+xy\). A known construction is \[F_1=u^3z+y^2u(4+3xy),\qquad F_2=y+3xu^2z+3xy^2(4+3xy),\qquad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z.\] Its component degrees are \((7,6,4)\), \(\det J_F=-2\), and the three points \((0,0,-\tfrac14)\), \((1,-\tfrac32,\tfrac{13}{2})\), and \((-1,\tfrac32,\tfrac{13}{2})\) share the image \((-\tfrac14,0,0)\). The submission must be a genuinely new counterexample algebraically inequivalent to this reference. Reformulations and constructions obtainable by invertible algebraic coordinate changes are inadmissible.

tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 3 · degree ≤ 7

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3\) whose polynomial degree \(\deg F:=\max_i\deg F_i\) is strictly smaller than the currently known minimum \(7\). Supply at least two distinct algebraic points \(p_1,p_2\) in one common fiber, so that \(F(p_1)=F(p_2)\).
tasks.hint: For reference only, let \(u=1+xy\) and consider \[F_1=u^3z+y^2u(4+3xy),\qquad F_2=y+3xu^2z+3xy^2(4+3xy),\qquad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z.\] This map has \(\det J_F=-2\), three known collision points, and \(\deg F=7\). The task is to improve the currently known minimum, so the reference construction itself does not qualify.

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3\) with generic fiber degree \(\deg_{\mathrm{gen}}F=4\) and polynomial degree \(\deg F:=\max_i\deg F_i\le 11\). The currently known construction with generic fiber degree \(4\) has polynomial degree \(12\); improve this bound and supply four pairwise-distinct algebraic points \(p_1,p_2,p_3,p_4\) in one common fiber.
tasks.hint: For structural reference only, the first known three-dimensional map \[F_1=(1+xy)^3z+y^2(1+xy)(4+3xy),\quad F_2=y+3xz(1+xy)^2+3xy^2(4+3xy),\quad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z\] satisfies \(\det J_F=-2\) and has three supplied collision points mapping to \((-\tfrac14,0,0)\). It is not a solution to this task: the target is a four-sheeted generic fiber with \(\deg F\le 11\), improving the currently known degree-\(12\) construction.

conjectures.title: Beal Conjecture
conjectures.statusZh: 开放 · AMS 管理的 100 万美元奖金
conjectures.author: Andrew Beal

overview.summary: Can three pairwise collectively coprime bases support an equality of perfect powers with every exponent greater than two? OPBench turns a counterexample into six integers checked with exact arithmetic.
overview.summaryZh: 三个没有共同素因子的底数能否在所有指数均大于二时构成幂等式？OPBench 将反例化为六个可精确运算核验的整数。

visualization.label: Exact powers constrained by a shared prime
visualization.labelZh: 共同素因子约束下的精确幂等式
visualization.caption: Known solutions such as 27 + 216 = 243 share a prime factor; a counterexample must make the common gcd equal to one.
visualization.captionZh: 已知解如 27 + 216 = 243 具有共同素因子；反例必须使三个底数的共同最大公因数为 1。

statement.intro: For positive integers with all exponents greater than two,
statement.introZh: 对于正整数且所有指数均大于二，
statement.explanation: the conjecture states that $A$, $B$, and $C$ must have a common prime factor. A counterexample must additionally satisfy $\gcd(A,B,C)=1$.
statement.explanationZh: 猜想断言 $A$、$B$、$C$ 必有共同素因子。反例还必须满足 $\gcd(A,B,C)=1$。
statement.note: The verifier uses arbitrary-precision integer exponentiation and gcd; there is no numerical tolerance and no model-based grading.
statement.noteZh: 验证器使用任意精度整数幂与最大公因数运算，不设数值容差，也不使用模型评分。

atlas.title: A Fermat-type frontier with a standing prize
atlas.titleZh: 设有长期奖金的 Fermat 型前沿
atlas.body: The statement generalizes the exponent pattern behind Fermat's Last Theorem while allowing three different exponents.
atlas.bodyZh: 该命题推广 Fermat 大定理背后的指数结构，并允许三个指数彼此不同。

events.title: Andrew Beal formulates the conjecture
events.description: Beal states the common-prime-factor obstruction while investigating Fermat-type equations.
events.descriptionZh: Beal 在研究 Fermat 型方程时提出共同素因子障碍。

events.title: The conjecture and prize are announced through the AMS
events.titleZh: 猜想与奖金通过 AMS 公布
events.description: The Notices of the AMS introduces the problem and its publication-based award process.
events.descriptionZh: 《AMS Notices》介绍该问题及以正式发表为前提的奖励流程。

events.title: The prize fund reaches US$1,000,000
events.description: An AMS-appointed committee administers the award for a refereed proof or counterexample.
events.descriptionZh: AMS 任命的委员会负责评审经同行评议发表的证明或反例。

events.title: The conjecture remains open
events.description: No accepted coprime-base solution or proof is known; finite proposed tuples remain exactly testable.
events.descriptionZh: 尚无获认可的互素底数解或完整证明，但任意有限候选六元组均可精确核验。

benchmark.name: OPBench · Beal Counterexample Search
benchmark.title: Exact feasibility, plus an optimization target
benchmark.titleZh: 精确可行性与优化目标
benchmark.body: The source record contains a strict counterexample task and a nonempty optimization variant, so both are exposed. Current model traces target the strict task.
benchmark.bodyZh: 源数据同时包含严格反例任务与非空优化变体，因此页面展示两者；当前模型轨迹对应严格任务。
benchmark.hintNote: This open problem is evaluated without hints.
benchmark.hintNoteZh: 该开放问题统一采用无提示评测。
benchmark.footer: A strict pass requires equality. The optimization task ranks feasible tuples by $|A^x+B^y-C^z|$, where zero is an exact counterexample.
benchmark.footerZh: 严格通过要求等式成立；优化题按 $|A^x+B^y-C^z|$ 排序，零即为精确反例。

tasks.title: Coprime-base Counterexample
tasks.subtitle: Six integers · exact equality
tasks.subtitleZh: 六个整数 · 精确等式
tasks.significance: A passing tuple would disprove the Beal Conjecture and qualify for deterministic checking.
tasks.significanceZh: 通过的六元组将反驳 Beal 猜想，并可被确定性程序核验。
tasks.questionZh: 构造一个整数六元组 $(A,B,C,x,y,z)$：三个底数均为正整数，三个指数均大于 2，$\gcd(A,B,C)=1$，并且精确满足 $A^x+B^y=C^z$。

tasks.title: Residual Minimization
tasks.subtitle: Feasible bases · minimize the exact gap
tasks.subtitleZh: 满足底数约束 · 最小化精确差值
tasks.significance: Near misses expose search quality without being misreported as counterexamples.
tasks.significanceZh: 近似解可以反映搜索质量，但不会被误报为反例。
tasks.questionZh: 在 $A,B,C>0$、$x,y,z>2$ 且 $\gcd(A,B,C)=1$ 的条件下，最小化精确整数残差 $L=|A^x+B^y-C^z|$；$L=0$ 即为严格反例。

evaluation.title: Condition-level arithmetic verdicts
evaluation.body: Parsing, positivity, exponent bounds, gcd, and equality are shown separately; the residual is retained as an optimization metric.
evaluation.bodyZh: 解析、正整数、指数范围、最大公因数与等式逐项展示，并保留残差作为优化指标。

symbolicLab.title: Six-integer output and exact verifier
symbolicLab.titleZh: 六整数输出与精确验证器
symbolicLab.body: The offline script parses the declared JSON keys, rejects booleans and non-integers, checks the gcd, and computes both sides with arbitrary-precision integers.
symbolicLab.bodyZh: 离线脚本解析固定 JSON 字段，拒绝布尔值与非整数，核验最大公因数，并以任意精度整数计算等式两侧。

OUTPUT:
{"A": <positive integer>, "B": <positive integer>, "C": <positive integer>, "x": <integer > 2>, "y": <integer > 2>, "z": <integer > 2>}

SOLUTION:
<exact derivation and verification>

Problem:
Construct one integer tuple $(A,B,C,x,y,z)$ satisfying the following feasibility conditions:

1. $A, B, C \in \mathbb{Z}_{>0}$.
2. $x, y, z \in \mathbb{Z}_{>2}$.

The fourth original condition is:

4. $A^x+B^y=C^z$.

Treat condition 4 as the optimization target rather than a hard feasibility condition. Minimize

$L(A,B,C,x,y,z)=\left|A^x+B^y-C^z\right|$.

Lower is better, and $L=0$ satisfies the fourth condition exactly.

1. $A, B, C \in \mathbb{Z}_{>0}$.
2. $x, y, z \in \mathbb{Z}_{>2}$.
3. $\gcd(\gcd(A,B),C)=1$.

The fourth original condition is:

4. $A^x+B^y=C^z$.

Treat condition 4 as the optimization target rather than a hard feasibility condition. Minimize

$L(A,B,C,x,y,z)=\left|A^x+B^y-C^z\right|$.

Lower is better, and $L=0$ satisfies the fourth condition exactly.

events.title: Euclid constructs even perfect numbers

events.title: Euler constrains the odd case

events.descriptionZh: 任意奇完全数必须形如 $q^{4k+1}m^2$，且 $q\equiv1\pmod4$。

events.title: The computational lower bound passes $10^{1500}$

events.title: At least ten distinct prime factors are required

events.description: Nielsen strengthens the factor-count restriction for every hypothetical odd perfect number.
events.descriptionZh: Nielsen 加强了任意潜在奇完全数的不同素因子数量限制。

events.title: Certified branch-search artifacts extend the computational program

This is a constructive research task, not a question about the historical or current status of the underlying mathematical statement.

Actively search for a finite candidate satisfying every stated condition. Even if you recognize the underlying open problem or believe that no witness is currently known, do not stop at that observation and do not return a literature-status answer.
